name: King of the Hill
hook: Hold the snowy hilltop alone. Shove everyone off.
how: Every second you stand alone on the icy top of the hill scores a point; two or more up there and nobody scores. Shove the others down the slope, and the highest score when the clock runs out wins.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to move and Space to shove, or the touch stick and Shove button
uses: The host's browser decides every shove and counts every point; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the hill until enough people join, climbing and shoving like players.
Everyone sees the same shoves, tumbles and scores as they happen.
The best scores anyone has made in one game, on the results card.
ideas: Make it a sandcastle on a beach
Add a power-up snowball that knocks people further
Make the hilltop move around the map every 20 seconds
